Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains how Global Job Matching collects, uses and protects your information.
Privacy.s1Body: Account data (email, name, role), profile and resume data you provide, usage events and payment metadata needed to process subscriptions.
Privacy.s2Body: To operate the marketplace, authenticate users, improve matching, enforce plan limits and communicate service-related messages.
Privacy.s3Body: We do not sell personal data. Limited data may be shared with infrastructure providers (hosting, email, storage) under contractual safeguards.
Privacy.s4Body: We retain account data while your account is active and as needed for legal, security and billing records.
Privacy.s5Body: You may request access, correction or deletion of your account data through settings or contact, subject to legal obligations.
Privacy.s6Body: We use industry-standard measures such as encrypted transport and access controls. No transmission method is 100% secure.
Privacy.s7Body: Privacy questions can be sent through the contact page.
